title: Design System for Meta Ads' Lift
subtitle: Scaling consistency across a complex enterprise advertising platform.

tracks.title: Title
tracks.about: Design System for Meta Ads' Lift — Scaling consistency across a complex enterprise advertising platform.

tracks.title: Problem
tracks.about: Context: Lift, Meta Ads, enterprise scale. Fragmentation — up to 10 UI patterns, confusion; product had scaled faster than its design foundation.

tracks.title: Insight
tracks.about: Product had scaled faster than its design foundation; consistency and shared patterns are prerequisites for quality at scale.

tracks.title: Approach
tracks.about: Lift Results Design System strategy — scalable component library, shared patterns, tokens, documentation. Modular, documented, code-ready.

tracks.title: Architecture
tracks.about: Design system structure; component library architecture; documentation and token system.

tracks.title: UX challenges
tracks.about: Consistency at scale; reducing 10+ patterns to a single source of truth; adoption across teams.

tracks.title: Design System
tracks.about: Lift Results Design System — component library, tokens, shared patterns, documentation.

tracks.title: Engineering & implementation
tracks.about: Partnership with engineering; code alignment; documentation; handoff and implementation support.

tracks.title: Outcome
tracks.about: Adoption strategy; impact: 90% compliance before org target, 13/16 improvements shipped, UX quality gains.
